thig6.4:1.1: alaṃkatā suvasanā mālinī candanokkhitā | sabbābharaṇasañchannā dāsīgaṇapurakkhatā || ||
thig6.4:2.1: annaṃ pānaṃ ca ādāya khajjaṃ bhojjaṃ anappakaṃ | gehato nikkhamitvāna uyyānam abhihārayiṃ. || ||
thig6.4:3.1: tattha ramitvā kīḷitvā āgacchantī sakaṃ gharaṃ | vihāraṃ dakkhiṃ pāvisiṃ Sākete Añjanaṃ vanaṃ. || ||
thig6.4:4.1: disvāna lokapajjotaṃ vanditvāna upāvisiṃ | so me dhammam adesesi anukampāya cakkhumā. || ||
thig6.4:5.1: sutvā ca kho mahesissa saccaṃ sampaṭivijjh' ahaṃ | tatth' eva virajaṃ dhammaṃ phusayiṃ amataṃ padaṃ. || ||
thig6.4:6.1: tato viññātasaddhammā pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ | tisso vijjā anuppattā amoghaṃ buddhasāsanaṃ. || || Sujātā. ||
